name: Park Street
desc1: This park is the pride of Silvermere. Gorgeous white-skinned trees
desc2: lines the paths, their golden leaves shrouding them like a glimmering
desc3: aura. Birds chirp cheerfully in the branches, and small, furry
desc4: animals scurry about on the grass-carpeted earthen floor. You can
desc5: follow the paths through the park to the north, east and west, and
desc6: into the centre of the park to the south.
